<!-- Generated by Kora's design director. This is the design decision the site was built
     from. Business: 32th Oral Care -->

# DESIGN.md — 32th Oral Care

archetype: approachable-local
rationale: A family dental practice led by a named dentist in a small New York town wins patients the same way a trusted neighbour does — warmth, legibility and an obvious invitation to walk in; the approachable-local direction gives 32th Oral Care exactly that register without the cold authority of a corporate-confident site or the austerity of architectural-minimal, both of which would undercut the "gentle, modern family dentistry" promise.
interaction_level: L2

personality: [warm, precise, reassuring, modern]

typography:
  display: "Nunito"
  body: "Nunito"
  scale: 1.25
  notes: >
    h1 at 3.5rem / 700 weight, tracked at −0.01em; h2 at 2.25rem / 700; h3 at 1.5rem / 600;
    body at 1.0625rem / 400, line-height 1.7; service eyebrow labels in Nunito 600 small-caps
    at 0.75rem, letter-spaced 0.12em; captions and fine print at 0.875rem / 400 in secondary colour.
    No serif faces anywhere — Nunito's rounded terminals carry the warmth the brand mood calls for.

palette:
  primary: "#1c3c56"
  secondary: "#eef4f2"
  accent: "#2f9aa8"
  application: >
    #1c3c56 carries the header background, the footer band, section headings and the primary CTA
    button. #eef4f2 is the page ground and alternating section tint bands. #2f9aa8 appears on
    interactive hover states, the "Visit us" button outline variant, hairline rules under category
    eyebrows, and the accent moment in the hero standfirst. White (#ffffff) is used for type on
    dark surfaces and for card interiors where cards appear. No gradients.

composition:
  whitespace: generous
  photography: supporting
  card_usage: minimal
  mobile: >
    Header collapses to logo left + hamburger right; nav opens as a full-width drawer in #1c3c56
    with white Nunito 600 links at 1.25rem, stacked, centred. Hero switches from editorial-split
    to stacked — image above, text block below on #eef4f2 ground. Services grid goes to single
    column. Hours/location band stacks to one column. Footer stacks its three columns to one,
    centred, with 2rem gap between groups.

shell:
  header: >
    Sticky. Background #1c3c56. Height 68px. Horizontal padding 2rem (clamp to 1rem on mobile).
    Left: logo image (https://quseprdus1.blob.core.windows.net/kora-business-images/social-media/d9d3e3cf-e6f3-44e0-9876-83a0b241d44f/medialibrary/1789493252_27382k.png)
    at 40px height, auto width, vertically centred. Immediately right of logo: business name
    rendered as the literal string "32th Oral Care" in Nunito 700, 1.125rem, white, no
    text-transform. Gap between logo and name: 0.75rem. Right side: nav links (see nav list below)
    in Nunito 600, 0.9rem, white, no text-transform, letter-spacing 0.03em, gap 2rem between
    items; then a single CTA button labelled exactly "Visit us" — Nunito 700, 0.9rem, background
    #2f9aa8, white text, border-radius 6px, padding 0.5rem 1.25rem, margin-left 2rem. On scroll
    past 60px: header gains box-shadow 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); no height change, no colour
    change. Mobile: logo + "32th Oral Care" text left; hamburger icon (three 2px white lines,
    24px) right; nav and CTA hidden until drawer opens.
  nav: ["Home", "Services", "Hours"]
  footer: >
    Background #1c3c56. Padding 3rem 2rem 2rem. Three columns on desktop (equal thirds), one
    stacked on mobile.

    Column 1 — Brand:
      Business name as the literal string "32th Oral Care" in Nunito 700, 1.25rem, white.
      Below it, tagline as the literal string "Gentle, modern family dentistry in Brewster, New York"
      in Nunito 400, 0.875rem, #eef4f2, line-height 1.5.

    Column 2 — Hours:
      Eyebrow label: literal string "HOURS" in Nunito 600 small-caps, 0.75rem, #2f9aa8,
      letter-spacing 0.1em, margin-bottom 0.75rem.
      Hours set as an aligned day / time pair list — each row is two spans in a flex row,
      day name left-aligned in Nunito 600 white 0.875rem, time right-aligned in Nunito 400
      #eef4f2 0.875rem, with a dotted leader between them:
        "Monday"   "09:00 – 18:30"
        "Tuesday"  "09:00 – 17:00"
        "Wednesday" "09:00 – 17:00"
        "Thursday" "09:00 – 17:00"
        "Friday"   "09:00 – 14:00"
      Saturday and Sunday are not listed (not available).

    Column 3 — Find us:
      Eyebrow label: literal string "LOCATION" in Nunito 600 small-caps, 0.75rem, #2f9aa8,
      letter-spacing 0.1em, margin-bottom 0.75rem.
      One line in Nunito 400, #eef4f2, 0.875rem: "Brewster, New York"
      Below it, the "Visit us" CTA button — same style as header CTA — as the only action in
      the footer. No phone, no email (not available). No nav repeat in the footer.

    Below all three columns, a 1px rule in rgba(255,255,255,0.15), then a closing line in
    Nunito 400, 0.75rem, rgba(255,255,255,0.5), centred:
    "© 2025 32th Oral Care. All rights reserved."

pages:
  - slug: services
    title: "Dental Services — 32th Oral Care"
    description: "General, cosmetic, restorative, implants, emergency and family dentistry at 32th Oral Care in Brewster, New York. Gentle, modern care for every age."
    h1: "Our Dental Services"
    intent: "What treatments does this practice offer?"
    takes: [offerings]

  - slug: hours
    title: "Hours & Location — 32th Oral Care"
    description: "Opening hours and location for 32th Oral Care, family and cosmetic dentistry in Brewster, New York."
    h1: "Hours & Location"
    intent: "When are they open and where are they?"
    takes: [hours_location]

sections:
  - id: hero
    layout: editorial-split
    show: all
    spec: >
      Desktop: two equal columns, no gap, full viewport height (min 560px). Left column
      background #1c3c56; right column holds the single available image
      (https://quseprdus1.blob.core.windows.net/kora-business-images/social-media/d9d3e3cf-e6f3-44e0-9876-83a0b241d44f/medialibrary/1789493252_27382k.png)
      as an object-fit cover fill. Left column content centred vertically, padded 3rem 2.5rem:
      a small eyebrow in Nunito 600 small-caps #2f9aa8 reading "Brewster, New York"; below it
      the h1 "Gentle, modern family dentistry" in Nunito 700 3.5rem white, line-height 1.15;
      below that the practice description in Nunito 400 1.0625rem #eef4f2 max-width 38ch,
      line-height 1.7; then the "Visit us" button in #2f9aa8 background, white Nunito 700,
      border-radius 6px, padding 0.75rem 2rem, margin-top 2rem. No second button. No overlay
      on the image column. Mobile: image stacks above at 16:9 aspect ratio; left column
      content below on #1c3c56 ground, heading drops to 2.25rem.

  - id: story
    layout: quote-led
    show: all
    spec: >
      Full-width section on #eef4f2 ground, padding 5rem 2rem. A single oversized pull-quote
      in Nunito 700 italic, 2rem, #1c3c56, max-width 720px, centred horizontally on the page,
      line-height 1.35: "A warm, modern practice where every patient — from first visit to
      senior smiles — feels genuinely cared for." Attribution line beneath in Nunito 600
      small-caps #2f9aa8, 0.8rem, letter-spacing 0.1em: "Dr. Balu M. Krishna, DDS, MDS —
      32th Oral Care". Below the attribution, two short paragraphs of the practice description
      in Nunito 400 1.0625rem #1c3c56, max-width 640px, centred, line-height 1.7. No image,
      no card, no border. On mobile the quote drops to 1.5rem and padding reduces to 3rem 1.25rem.

  - id: offerings
    layout: editorial-list
    show: "6 of 6, all items, links to services.html"
    spec: >
      Section on white ground, padding 5rem 2rem. Section heading "Our Services" in Nunito 700
      2.25rem #1c3c56, left-aligned, with a 2px #2f9aa8 rule 2.5rem wide beneath it,
      margin-bottom 2.5rem. One category group "Dental Services" — category label rendered as
      Nunito 600 small-caps #2f9aa8 0.75rem letter-spaced 0.12em with a hairline #2f9aa8 rule
      beneath it, margin-bottom 1.5rem. Items in a two-column grid on desktop, one column on
      mobile. Each item: service name in Nunito 700 1.0625rem #1c3c56; description in Nunito 400
      0.9375rem #1c3c56 opacity 0.75, line-height 1.6, margin-top 0.25rem. No price (none
      available). No item image. No card border or shadow — items are separated by a 1px
      rgba(28,60,86,0.12) hairline rule only. A "See all services" text link in Nunito 600
      #2f9aa8 with a right-arrow glyph sits below the grid, right-aligned on desktop,
      centred on mobile, linking to services.html.

  - id: hours_location
    layout: stacked-band
    show: all
    spec: >
      Full-width band on #1c3c56 ground, padding 4rem 2rem. Two columns on desktop, one on
      mobile, gap 4rem. Left column: eyebrow "OPENING HOURS" in Nunito 600 small-caps #2f9aa8
      0.75rem letter-spacing 0.1em; below it the hours as an aligned day/time pair list —
      each row is a flex row with day name in Nunito 600 white 1rem left-aligned and time in
      Nunito 400 #eef4f2 1rem right-aligned, dotted leader between them, row gap 0.625rem:
        Monday 09:00 – 18:30
        Tuesday 09:00 – 17:00
        Wednesday 09:00 – 17:00
        Thursday 09:00 – 17:00
        Friday 09:00 – 14:00
      Right column: eyebrow "FIND US" in Nunito 600 small-caps #2f9aa8 0.75rem letter-spacing
      0.1em; below it "Brewster, New York" in Nunito 700 white 1.25rem; a short line in Nunito
      400 #eef4f2 0.9375rem: "Serving Brewster and the surrounding Putnam County communities."
      Then the "Visit us" button in #2f9aa8 background, white Nunito 700, border-radius 6px,
      padding 0.75rem 2rem, margin-top 1.5rem. No map embed (no address available).

avoid:
  - a three-column icon grid of "Gentle · Modern · Professional" or equivalent
  - stock photography of smiling models in dental chairs — only the provided logo image
  - a hero centred over three service cards
  - badge clip-art (tooth icons, star badges, "5-star" graphics)
  - any invented phone number, email address, street address or review quote
  - a reviews section (zero reviews available — omit entirely)
  - a gallery section (only one image available — omit entirely)
  - "solutions", "state-of-the-art", "cutting-edge" or other dental-site clichés
  - a contact form as the sole call to action when no email address is available to receive it
  - the word "Menu" anywhere on the site
